description: Canonical IvyPlay YouTube Channel Resolver contract. Add-ons may provide only standard Stremio fields; IvyPlay enriches missing YouTube metadata through the resolver.

sections.title: string
items: youtube item ids in source order

notes: home.sections order is authoritative and must be rendered without IvyPlay re-sorting.
Missing optional fields must not block rendering.
A flat video catalog is valid fallback data but is not evidence of the real YouTube Home section order.
Standard Stremio add-ons do not need to know this schema; IvyPlay maps/enriches them into it.
